sentences.text: Ms. Diksha Bisen - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Pramod Kumar Choubey- Government Advocate for th
respondent/State.

Order 
This is repeat (second) bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in jail since 23.10.2024 in connection with Crime No.230 of 2024 registered at P.S. Bichhiya, District-Mandla for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3), 376(2)(n)
of the IPC and Section 3/4(2) and 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
3. Applicant's first application was dismissed as withdrawn by order 18.02.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.No.6602 of 2025.
4. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 23.10.2024.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.

It is also NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:37338 2 MCRC-23861-2025 urged that after withdrawal of earlier application,
prosecutrix has been examined and she has turned hostile and she did not support the prosecution Ravindra Karcham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128920532/
1 story.

entities.text: Ravindra Karcham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: No injuries have been found on the person of prosecutrix.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
6. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
7. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

8. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
9. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
10. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to the applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
11. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
12. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37338 3 MCRC-23861-2025 vai Ravindra Karcham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128920532/
